text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: In my mind, Tanino Gimlet is the only choice for this year's Japan Cup!! Gimlet is definitely carrying Japan on her shoulders right now!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"God of Destruction"-sama...!!
Please, scorch this Tokyo Racecourse
to cinders with your brilliance...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Don't just look up to them.
Today, I will...—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: As a rival to defeat someday...! I'm gonna watch Gim-senpai run...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Even though it's the same Tokyo Racecourse,
it really feels different from the Japan Derby."
choice_data_list: That one's a once-in-a-lifetime chance, after all.
That one's a once-in-a-lifetime chance, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That is a factor.
However, more than that—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I myself have become
a completely different being from back then."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...How could I have ever imagined it?
That I would run beyond the very scenario I longed for,
and stand upon a stage such as this—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
choice_data_list: Because I was more obsessed with your potential than anyone else.
Because I was crazier about your potential than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Hahahahaha!!
No doubt about it...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Then let us go.
To show the world the brilliance you so desperately craved,
and the true nature of the 'God of Destruction'...!!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: (Heh heh, impressive as always...! Her soul is overflowing with such magnificent surges...!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ――Well, look who decided to show up, "God of Destruction."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"At the Tenno Sho (Autumn) the other day,
you put on quite a flashy show,
both in your running and your speech, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(...A passionate, free-spirited dancer.
Her bold, sweeping stride is just like a sailor catching the wind in their sails, huh—)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Looks like it's burning quite fiercely.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Of course! After all, the one I'm facing right now is the "God of Destruction" herself, trying to smash everything to pieces.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If I run with a half-hearted resolve
and tick her off, there's no telling what kind of
rough waves she'll stir up.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
So—I'm gonna take you down face-to-face with everything I've got.
And then, your myth will just be another souvenir story to bring back to my pals!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!! Such arrogance is truly delightful...!
Then allow me to shatter it.
Every last bit of the "destiny" you bear!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yet another... "distortion."
"Imitating antiquity" remains "impossible"...
It's practically become "correct" now, hasn't it...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
And this is... "Regenerate"—
"RÊVE", or perhaps... "Start Over"?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: No——"REVS", maybe "Evolution".

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Heh...—
They truly are alike...—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, tremble!! Resist me if you dare!!
O countless cosmic laws, O omnipresent destiny!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
My name is the "God of Destruction"!!
I am the one who destroys all and leads the way!!!!!!
